name: progress
title: Progress
description: Task progress: the pending signal made determinate (yellow fill, ink leading edge), indeterminate, complete and failed states.
whenToUse: Use it to show how far a task has got, including failure where it stopped. For a quantity against a limit use Meter; for content still loading use Skeleton.

parts.name: Progress
parts.description: Task progress: how far a job has got, not a measurement (that is Meter). It is the pending signal made determinate. Pending runs a yellow segment along a keyline; Progress fills the rail with the same yellow, and draws the fill's leading end as a keyline so the boundary reads in every theme. Uploading manifest.pdf 64% [▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓| ] k1 rail · yellow fill · ink leading edge 3.2 of 5 MB · about 12 s left - `value={null}`: indeterminate. The pending segment runs inside the rail (hatched and still under reduced motion). - Complete: the readout gains the done glyph. - `failed`: the fill turns red where it stopped and the readout says "Failed" with the attention glyph; say why and what to do in `detail`. Given `label`, it renders its parts itself; pass children (the parts) to compose them instead. Semantics (role="progressbar", value text, status attributes) and number formatting are Base UI Progress's.

props.name: children
props.description: The parts, composed: ProgressLabel, ProgressValue, ProgressTrack with ProgressIndicator, ProgressDetail.

props.name: detail
props.description: A line under the rail: amounts, time left, the failure's reason and what to do.

props.name: failed
props.description: The task stopped. The fill turns attention-red and the readout says so; `value` keeps how far it got.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hide the label and readout when the surrounding text already says both (a table cell, a toast).

props.name: label
props.description: What is in progress ("Uploading manifest.pdf"). Visible unless `hideLabel`.

parts.name: ProgressDetail
parts.description: A line under the rail: amounts, time left, or why the task failed and what to do. Point the root's `aria-describedby` at its id when you compose the parts.

parts.name: ProgressIndicator
parts.description: The fill (Base UI Progress.Indicator): yellow with an ink leading edge; red where a failed task stopped.

parts.name: ProgressLabel
parts.description: What is in progress (Base UI Progress.Label): it names the bar.

parts.name: ProgressTrack
parts.description: The rail (Base UI Progress.Track): a k1 keyline box, 10px tall.

parts.name: ProgressValue
parts.description: The readout (Base UI Progress.Value): the formatted value, with the done glyph when complete, or the failure with the attention glyph. Hidden from assistive technology; the bar's value text says the same. Pass children (a function of the formatted value and the value) to write it yourself.
